description:
Cripple Creek Veg Management Roads Reconstruction  
 CHUGACH NF  
This project includes subgrade construction, unsuitable material excavation and 
endhaul,aggregate placement for subgrade reinforcement, aggregate surfacing, clearing 
and grubbing,disposal site contouring, switchback realignment, waterbar construction 
and reconstruction,and all other work required to get these roads to a condition to 
place aggregate surface materials. Option item is road surfacing. 

  Questions Due:11/20  

  Proposals due: 12/04/2026 1700 PT
